title: Audit-First VAPO: Risk-Certified Selective Updates under Imperfect Verification
abstract: arXiv:2609.33662v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Imperfect verifiers can assign a harmful update direction even when clipping and regularization bound its magnitude. We introduce Audit-First VAPO, which separates discrete directional admission from continuous magnitude control. An observation-only accept-appeal-abstain policy uses a finite secondary-verification budget; its action trace is frozen before clean labels are joined. Simultaneous finite-sample bounds then certify selected harmful risk, coverage, and verifier-call rate over a predeclared policy family. Conditional Hoeffding-Azuma bounds account for the dependence induced by shared budgets, and rollout or verifier changes initiate a new certification stage. After admission, a bounded trust-clip-KL actuator controls magnitude. We evaluate two models on two reasoning benchmarks against static RLVR, matched-random selection, confidence thresholding, noise correction, and verifier augmentation. On Qwen3.5-0.8B and GSM8K at tar

translated_title: 审计优先的VAPO：不完美验证下的风险认证选择性更新
translated_abstract: 不完美的验证器即使在裁剪和正则化限制了其幅值的情况下，仍可能分配出有害的更新方向。我们提出了Audit-First VAPO，它将离散的方向准入与连续的幅值控制分离开来。一种仅用于观察的“接受-申诉-弃权”策略使用有限的二次验证预算；其动作轨迹在加入干净标签之前被冻结。随后，同时的有限样本界在一个预先声明的策略族上对选定的有害风险、覆盖率以及验证器调用率进行认证。条件Hoeffding-Azuma界解释了由共享预算所引起的依赖性，而rollout或验证器的变更会启动新的认证阶段。在准入之后，一个有界的trust-clip-KL执行器来控制幅值大小。我们在两个模型和两个推理基准上对该方法进行评估，对比了静态RLVR、匹配随机选择、置信度阈值、噪声校正以及验证器增强等基线方法。在Qwen3.5-0.8B和GSM8K上，在目标……
tldr: 该论文提出Audit-First VAPO框架，通过将更新方向的离散准入与幅值的连续控制相分离，在有限验证预算下利用“接受-申诉-弃权”观察策略和有限样本统计界，实现对不完美验证器下有害更新风险、覆盖率与验证器调用率的可认证保障。
en_tdlr: Audit-First VAPO separates discrete directional admission from continuous magnitude control, using an observation-only accept-appeal-abstain policy under a finite verification budget and finite-sample statistical bounds to certify harmful risk, coverage, and verifier-call rates when verification is imperfect.
